 Trial for Charlie Kirk’s accused killer to begin in summer 2028 A trial date has been set in Utah for the man charged with killing Charlie Kirk. Tyler Robinson faces death penalty charges in a trial that is expected to take months.

 Trial for Charlie Kirk's accused killer to begin in summer 2028
 November 10, 2026 4:38 AM ET 
 Heard on Morning Edition 
 From 
 By 
 Hugo Rikard-Bell
 Trial for Charlie Kirk's accused killer to begin in summer 2028
 Audio will be available later today. 
 A trial date has been set in Utah for the man charged with killing Charlie Kirk. Tyler Robinson faces death penalty charges in a trial that is expected to take months.
